title: Handlebar Remote
tagline: A thumb controller for the left handlebar, for the dash and your phone
summary: A small controller under your left thumb: a 5-way joystick and 2 buttons, glove-friendly and used without looking. It works the Handlebar Dash over its own wiring (one of the dash's expansion slots), and a phone or anything else over Bluetooth, as a keyboard with media keys. On its own slim clamp just inside the bike's left switch cube, sealed with a printed TPU keypad. General purpose: the bar size, the switch cube and the position are settings.
status: Designed and modelled (v1, checked in CAD, not printed or built yet). The joystick module and the boards have no published drawings: measure yours first. The firmware comes next.
see_sub: A 48 x 33 x 27 mm head over the left switch cube, the joystick under the thumb and 2 buttons beside it, on an arm from a slim clamp on the bar.

docs.label: README: what it does, how it's built, the wiring and the dash-bus messages

head.name: Head
head.what: The housing: the face with the joystick's and the 2 buttons' holes, the posts that hold the joystick module, the ears for the lid's screws (2 M2.5 inserts)
head.material: ASA (PETG for a first try). Face down

keypad.name: Keypad
keypad.what: One TPU sheet under the face: the 2 button domes come up through it, the joystick's stem pierces it. Glue its edge to the face's underside: it seals the holes

joy_cap.name: Joystick cap
joy_cap.what: A low mushroom cap that pushes onto the joystick's stem
joy_cap.material: ASA / PETG, or TPU for grip. Flat top down

back_lid.name: Back lid
back_lid.what: Closes the head (2 M2.5 screws); the ESP32-C3 and the CAN transceiver stick to it; the cable gland; the arm's boss (2 M3 inserts)

lid_gasket.name: Lid gasket
lid_gasket.what: A TPU ring in the lid's groove, squeezed 0.2 mm by the 2 screws

arm_clamp.name: Arm and clamp
arm_clamp.what: The slim bar clamp's upper half and the arm up to the back lid (2 M3 screws); 2 M4 inserts from below
arm_clamp.material: ASA / PETG, 100% infill round the clamp. The split face down

clamp_cap.name: Clamp cap
clamp_cap.what: The clamp's lower half: 2 M4 x 20 bolts up from below, a 1 mm rubber strip inside
clamp_cap.material: ASA / PETG, 100% infill. The split face down

remote_assembled.name: Assembled
remote_assembled.what: The whole remote on the bar, with stand-ins for the boards

params.name: face_tilt
params.label: Face tilted back toward your thumb

params.name: nav_top
params.label: Joystick: the stem's top above the board's underside
params.help: Under about 10.5 mm the stem can't reach its cap (the model says so).
